headline: Crypto TVL, DEX volumes and stablecoin data - 29 Oct 2026
summary: Ethereum leads TVL at $45.84bn followed by Bitcoin at $6.18bn and Base at $6.04bn. Uniswap V4 recorded the highest 24h DEX volume at $1.17bn while Tether generated the top fees at $17.26m. USDT circulation stands at $180.82bn and USDC at $71.33bn with several stablecoins showing peg deviations. Base holds the largest L2 TVS at $14.73bn amid multiple security incidents reported in the prior fortnight.
